default.$description: Visible edge of controls such as inputs, checkboxes and the off toggle. Meets 3:1 on the page.

subtle.$description: Decorative dividers and card outlines. Not for controls.

action.$description: Brand coloured edge for outlined actions and active elements.

error.$description: Error border, for example on an invalid input.

selection-default.$description: Edge of a selected item such as a chosen select tile.

shadow-1.$description: Shadow colour for elevation level 1 (1 lowest, 5 highest). Used by the shadow xs to xl styles.

shadow-2.$description: Shadow colour for elevation level 2 (1 lowest, 5 highest). Used by the shadow xs to xl styles.

shadow-3.$description: Shadow colour for elevation level 3 (1 lowest, 5 highest). Used by the shadow xs to xl styles.

shadow-4.$description: Shadow colour for elevation level 4 (1 lowest, 5 highest). Used by the shadow xs to xl styles.

shadow-5.$description: Shadow colour for elevation level 5 (1 lowest, 5 highest). Used by the shadow xs to xl styles.

default.$description: Default icons next to primary text.

on-action.$description: Icons on brand and selection fills such as button icons.

action.$description: Interactive icons in the brand colour such as icon buttons.

base-3.$description: Raised containers such as cards and sheets.

base-4.$description: Surfaces above base-3, such as nested cards and popovers.

secondary-default.$description: Fill of neutral, low emphasis actions such as the secondary button.

secondary-hover.$description: Fill of neutral, low emphasis actions such as the secondary button. Hover state.

secondary-pressed.$description: Fill of neutral, low emphasis actions such as the secondary button. Pressed state.

secondary-disabled.$description: Fill of neutral, low emphasis actions such as the secondary button. Disabled state.

tertiary-default.$description: Background of form controls and neutral hover and pressed states.

tertiary-hover.$description: Background of form controls and neutral hover and pressed states. Hover state.

tertiary-pressed.$description: Background of form controls and neutral hover and pressed states. Pressed state.

tertiary-disabled.$description: Background of form controls and neutral hover and pressed states. Disabled state.

on-action.$description: White fill that stays white in both themes, for elements placed on action colours.

selection-default.$description: Fill of selected controls such as a checked toggle, checkbox or radio.

selection-hover.$description: Fill of selected controls such as a checked toggle, checkbox or radio. Hover state.

selection-disabled.$description: Fill of selected controls such as a checked toggle, checkbox or radio. Disabled state.

brand-default.$description: Fill of primary actions such as the primary button.

brand-hover.$description: Fill of primary actions such as the primary button. Hover state.

brand-pressed.$description: Fill of primary actions such as the primary button. Pressed state.

brand-disabled.$description: Fill of primary actions such as the primary button. Disabled state.

brand-light-default.$description: Soft tinted brand fill for secondary brand actions and chips.

brand-light-hover.$description: Soft tinted brand fill for secondary brand actions and chips. Hover state.

brand-light-pressed.$description: Soft tinted brand fill for secondary brand actions and chips. Pressed state.

brand-light-disabled.$description: Soft tinted brand fill for secondary brand actions and chips. Disabled state.

error-default.$description: Soft error background for alerts, banners and error fields.

error-hover.$description: Soft error background for alerts, banners and error fields. Hover state.

error-pressed.$description: Soft error background for alerts, banners and error fields. Pressed state.

error-disabled.$description: Soft error background for alerts, banners and error fields. Disabled state.

error-strong-default.$description: Solid error fill for badges and strong emphasis.

success-strong.$description: Solid success fill for badges and strong emphasis.

success-strong-hover.$description: Solid success fill for badges and strong emphasis. Hover state.

success-strong-pressed.$description: Solid success fill for badges and strong emphasis. Pressed state.

success-strong-disabled.$description: Solid success fill for badges and strong emphasis. Disabled state.

success-light-default.$description: Soft success background for alerts, banners and success fields.

success-light-hover.$description: Soft success background for alerts, banners and success fields. Hover state.

success-light-pressed.$description: Soft success background for alerts, banners and success fields. Pressed state.

success-light-disabled.$description: Soft success background for alerts, banners and success fields. Disabled state.

warning-default.$description: Soft warning background for alerts and banners.

warning-strong.$description: Solid warning fill for badges and strong emphasis.

overlay.$description: Dimming layer behind modals and drawers.

tooltip-toast.$description: Background of tooltips and toasts. Dark in Light mode, white in Dark mode.

primary.$description: Default text such as body copy, headings and labels. Highest contrast.

secondary.$description: Supporting text such as captions, helper text and metadata.

disabled.$description: Text of disabled elements. Not for content people need to read.

inverse.$description: Text on inverted surfaces such as tooltips and toasts. Flips with the theme.

on-action.$description: Text on brand and strong status fills such as button labels. White in both themes.

on-white.$description: Text that stays dark on a light fill in both themes.

error.$description: Error message and status text. Pair with the matching border, icon or surface.

success.$description: Success message and status text. Pair with the matching border, icon or surface.

warning.$description: Warning message and status text. Pair with the matching border, icon or surface.

info.$description: Info message and status text. Pair with the matching border, icon or surface.
